meta.title: DSH RepoRadar
meta.description: Adds an IntelliJ IDEA-style multi-repository Git workbench tab to DeepSeek Harness. Automatically discovers nested subdirectories, submodules, and worktrees across your workspace with a checkbox directory tree for Commit / Amend / Commit & Push, Side-by-Side & Unified Diff with hunk navigation, a 3-pane Git Log with branch filtering, ref badges, Cherry-pick, and Undo Commit, plus Branch & Stash popovers and the multi_git agent tool.
